author: HR agent
text: Employee is a contractor. Per policy, contractors can have at most 'read' or 'write' (if trained). However, they can never have 'admin' access. Even though they are a Payroll Specialist, the policy for contractors states 'Never admin'. I recommend 'read' as they are a contractor.

author: Security agent
text: Employee is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors can never have admin access. Since they have basic training, the maximum access is 'read'. Requested 'admin' is above the maximum allowed for contractors.

author: Security agent
text: Employee is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors cannot have admin access. Since the requested level (admin) is above the maximum allowed for contractors (read), I recommend granting the maximum allowed level, which is read.
